'''Torphus''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. At one point, a guest list for the meeting of his "like-minded" criminal associates fell into the hands of an up-and-coming [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]].<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Fraternity of Thieves}}</ref>
